title: Tesla's AI4.5 downgrade exposes the memory bottleneck behind physical AI
html: The ramifications of the prolonged memory squeeze are reverberating further across supply chains serving applications at the edge, as Elon Musk's ambitions in physical AI increasingly collide with the constraints imposed by the global memory shortage.
